_purpose: A small, source-linked directory for food-access planning. Each record was checked against its official provider page on 2026-09-08. This is not a live inventory, reservation, appointment-booking, eligibility, or real-time closure feed.
_use_rules: Use only records whose status is published and whose service_area is known to include the resident, or show the option as conditional when service area is unknown.
Materialize recurring_schedule into calendar dates in America/Chicago; do not treat a weekly rule as proof that a holiday exception does not apply.
Display cost, appointment_required, languages, and visit_limit as unknown when the source did not state them; do not infer them.
Show source_url, source_retrieved_on, review_due_on, and record uncertainties in resident-facing results.
Ask the resident to call the provider before travel when a schedule, holiday exception, service area, or access rule is uncertain or stale.
Do not claim inventory, food quantities, reservation, appointment, eligibility approval, or successful pickup from these records.

_field_notes.status: published means an official provider page presented the program on the retrieval date; it does not establish that it is open today.
_field_notes.cost: free, paid, sliding, or unknown. Unknown is intentionally not inferred from a program name or a general food-pantry description.
_field_notes.appointment_required: yes, no, or unknown. Unknown means the official source did not establish the answer.
_field_notes.service_area: A ZIP list or geographic wording reproduced from the official source. An empty ZIP list means the agent must not assume coverage based only on the physical address.
_field_notes.recurring_schedule.frequency: weekly, first_weekday_of_month, or second_and_fourth_weekday_of_month. Apply holiday notes before proposing a dated visit.
_field_notes.source_retrieved_on: The date GoodNext checked the cited official page, not a provider's verification timestamp.

_maintenance.directory_owner: GoodNext maintainer — owner assignment required before public recommendations
